data.narrative:
Albedo is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $130M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the same sector and stage—Sierra Space ($8.0B Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B Series C)—alongside reference to 5 public Space & Aerospace comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median P/S of 27.4x.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using $130M total raised as a proxy and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields $247M. Peer-median valuation across the 4 same-sector comps produces $1.6B, with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure typical for private companies.

The triangulated range spans $210M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $948M. The wide spread reflects material dispersion in comparable valuations and methodological differences between stage-progression and peer multiples. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory relative to peers, technology maturity, and which stage peers most accurately represent Albedo's risk profile.
